1 (Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that is __water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2 (Original): The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation, wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated.

4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation, wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated.

5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme selected from the group consisting of __cell wall degrading enzymes__.

6 (Original): The method of claim 8 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA.

8 (Currently amended): The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material.

9 (Original): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

10 (Original): The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of__ genotyping.

12 (Original): The method of claim 15 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed.

14 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype.

15 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.

16 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated.
